results.title: Water Park Shark
results.overview: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

results.title: Dirty Angel
results.overview: A young woman gets involved in a typhoon of temptation, pressure, buried secrets and dangerous individuals that prowl the nocturnal streets and has to use her internal strength to create a new balance in her shattered life and start living to the fullest once again.

results.title: Frangines
results.overview: Frangines tells the story of Alice's reclusive life in an apartment perpetually shrouded in darkness. A disturbing presence, which she calls "The Dark Thoughts", is preventing her from leaving her mental prison and escaping. But just outside, her sister urges her to return to the light, and thus, to freedom.

results.title: Betty
results.overview: Betty, an acclaimed, but washed-up painter, is commissioned to create an art piece for a prestigious museum. In order to regain the creative brilliance of the suffering artist, she isolates herself in a secluded house with one ambition: to induce depression.

results.title: Juana
results.overview: Juana is a woman driven by an unshakable sense of duty who delves into infamous crimes against women, giving herself entirely to the pursuit of truth. Each revelation carries weight and each step forward increases the tension, drawing the viewer into a world where obsession, courage, and vulnerability collide.

results.title: I Know Catherine, the Log Lady
results.original_title: I Know Catherine, the Log Lady
results.overview: An authorized feature documentary about Catherine E. Coulson, best known as the Log Lady in David Lynch & Mark Frost's "Twin Peaks".

results.title: Horst Schlämmer sucht das Glück
results.overview: Horst Schlämmer is back—and he's fed up. People all over Germany are in a bad mood. So he leaves Grevenbroich and sets off in search of happiness. It must be somewhere!

results.title: No Pain
results.overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

results.title: Demon Squad: Tooth and Claw
results.overview: When a string of brutal killings are linked to a werewolf, paranormal investigator Nick Moon goes on the hunt. Battling supernatural forces, he uncovers a dark conspiracy that must be stopped before the monster strikes again.

results.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+: Mickey's Country Farm
results.original_title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+: Mickey's Country Farm
results.overview: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

results.title: Uang Passolo -Amplop Kondangan-
results.overview: Biba, a low-paid teacher, and Rizky, a struggling wedding videographer, are caught in a family sabotage of a lavish wedding, obsessed with showing off and hoping for a fat envelope. Their dream of a simple wedding is threatened, and the future of their marriage is at stake.

results.title: Something Familiar
results.overview: While helping another woman search for her birth mother, a filmmaker reopens her own family story. In searching for her missing sisters, she unearths a legacy of abuse and exploitation, and begins to ask: can the creative power of self-authorship help her rewrite the scripts she has inherited?

results.title: The Golden Key: A New Pinocchio Story
results.overview: A screen adaptation of the beloved international fairy tale by Alexei Tolstoy in a new way. The story of everyone's favorite hero Pinocchio, his dad Carlo and their friends, told with the help of modern life-action technologies.

results.title: A Christmas Ornament to Remember
results.overview: A big city veterinarian rushes home to help her family recover from a devastating storm and save the tree lighting, but finds her mission complicated when a mysterious Christmas ornament arrives and sets her back on a path back to love.

results.title: Girl Dad
results.overview: A tough, queer teenager leaves Brooklyn for the first time to spend the summer with her estranged, struggling composer father in Los Angeles. The two are forced to reconnect over a used refrigerator, that nearly upends and further strains their father-daughter relationship in the process.

results.title: The Untold Story of No Retreat No Surrender
results.original_title: The Untold Story of No Retreat No Surrender
results.overview: Exploring the story behind the 1980s cult classic, examining the mix of Hong Kong action with Western storytelling, how Kurt McKinney inspired kids and teenagers to fight back against bullies, how the world was introduced to Jean Claude Van Damme,  and how it impacted the VHS generation.

results.title: Broad Trip
results.overview: When buttoned-up daughter Alice plans a “bachelorette” road trip with her wild and impulsive mother, Jeanie, to talk her out of marrying a guy she just met, they rediscover their unbreakable bond, confronting old wounds and old flames, while learning the lesson that sometimes life doesn’t follow a plan — and maybe that’s okay.

results.title: Ramy Youssef: In Love
results.overview: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

results.title: Green Grass
results.overview: A checked-out undergrad gets lumped with the new Deaf classmate and starts to discover the cost of his life's choices, set in the seagrass meadows and stuffy classrooms of the British coast.  Declan is a disengaged biology student who cares more about drawing than his degree, but now in his second year, where grades count, even his closest friends don’t want to partner with him for this term’s assignment. Out of options, Declan is forced to work with the new girl, Claire, a proud and ambitious Deaf eco-activist pushing through the lack of accessibility in universities. On the mudflats and pebbled shores of the south English coast, their different attitudes quickly bubble to the surface, but so might long- hidden secrets and a friendship if they stand in the seagrass long enough.
